content.text: Hi, the headphones from order ORD-1042 stopped working. I want my money back.
Sure, I can help with that. Could you please provide the email address you used for this order?

We need to verify identity first. Ask for email. Then lookup_customer, then get_order, check if order belongs to that customer, check status delivered, delivery date within 30 days from current date (2026-06-15). Need to see order details. First ask email.
